proof_audit.v13-c12-welfare: Pass. Strict derivative signs give the complete clipped weighted optimum, including equality and zero/one weights. A separate increasing-utility resource argument proves the entire full-use Pareto frontier. Ordinal transformations and positive-affine expected-utility transformations are distinguished; neither supplies interpersonal weights. The matching exercise proves every blocker without inheriting broader matching results.
proof_audit.v13-c12-global: Pass. Continuity on the compact interval gives attainment; exact factorization and signs exhaust all stationary and endpoint candidates. Negative own curvature at one stationary point does not establish global optimality. The approximation proof inserts the computed objective twice and requires a genuine global approximate-supremum gap. It does not assume a maximizer of the computed objective. A finite two-point witness attains the whole 2 epsilon + eta bound.
proof_audit.v13-c12-selection: Pass. Every pure/independent-mixed support is derived from the adoption-gain signs, including the double-equality subsidy boundary. Sponsor cash covers both grants in every realization; expected sponsor losses cancel grants from aggregate welfare. The correlated law conditions incentives on recommendations, and all four binary obedience inequalities hold. Equal independent marginals fail a profitable deviation, so no selection or implementation theorem is inferred from them.
proof_audit.v13-c12-approximation: Pass after the recorded attainment repair. Monotone endpoint bounds establish invariance; geometric increments make all iterates Cauchy; closedness, continuity and strict contraction separately give existence, fixed-point status and uniqueness. The algebraic root outside the domain is excluded. True residual, parameter-map difference and computed-map error use distinct triangle inequalities. The two claimed tolerances are incompatible. The constant upward map shift attains the minimum computed residual, whereas the larger parameter shift explains an exact fixed point of a changed model.
proof_audit.v13-c12-identification: Pass after the coordinator's funding repair. Both models generate the same full baseline joint state/price/quantity law. Their cash-limited off-equilibrium responses come from globally strictly concave choice problems on the funded sets. Supply is nondecreasing and positive demand strictly decreases, proving at most one clearing price; the explicit strictly funded solution proves existence. Eliminating prices independently reproduces each statewise tax result. Buyer, producer and government transfers cancel, while production consumes actual resources. The pilot discriminates only the maintained two-model class under justified error and policy-invariance assumptions.
proof_audit.v13-c12-referee: Pass. Full adoption is uniquely efficient, but the funded fair grant retains every derived pure/mixed equilibrium. If both grants weakly undercut costs, no adoption survives; a grant strictly above one cost makes that agent dominant and forces the other to adopt because benefit exceeds its cost. This proves the all-equilibrium iff, strict budget boundary and nonattainment. The asymmetric equality segment is complete. The cost rectangle is solved by worst-corner necessity and uniform dominance, and equal grants change the feasible policy set. The sponsor's loss defeats the inclusive Pareto claim. The complete report distinguishes required theorem repairs, new primitives, selection and empirical evidence from optional extensions.

independent_methods: Derived weighted quantities from the rational derivative numerator. Enumerated all seven partial two-by-two matchings and tested every blocker before summing original and independently rescaled assigned values.

Expanded the derivative's linear factors as polynomial coefficients, evaluated every feasible endpoint/stationary candidate, and built the sharp two-point objective certificate. No local solver or action grid was used.

Intersected exact interval inequalities for all nine binary support cells, including open interior supports and asymmetric equality segments. This differs from the author's direct regime classifier. Enumerated the four joint action states to reconstruct every grant, sponsor balance, utility, real welfare and recommendation-contingent deviation.
Computed rational map roots, monotone extrema, true residuals, shifted maps and local/secant sensitivities. The minimum-residual witness uses a constant shift and remains in the invariant interval.

Eliminated prices using marginal real cost and the primitive benefit curvature, then reconstructed all statewise monetary and welfare accounts. Independent off-equilibrium witnesses establish why both financing caps are necessary. Exact model-mean intervals retain the touching boundary.
Compared all 26 primitive markers and 75 result markers against these calculations. Invalid-domain checks and final payload bindings are separate from the full universal-proof reading.
